title: Parameter file of tpg-helm-addons
description: The parameter file of `argo submit --from workflowtemplate/tpg-helm-addons --parameter-file`: the inputs of the WorkflowTemplate tpg-helm-addons. Generated from workflows/params/types.yaml and the template by workflows/params/params_schema.py. The shape, the types, the allowed values and the mandatory inputs; the validate step of the workflow and the admission policy tpg-workflow-parameters remain the authority (inputs that are mandatory in some cases only, combinations, registered clusters, the inside of clusterMap).

clusters.description: List: registered clusters in brackets, [aks-tpg-poc-01, aks-tpg-poc-02] (also with one value), or all [List; mandatory]

components.description: auto (cert-manager and vso, plus monitoring when tpg-settings monitoringOption=standalone), or a list in brackets of cert-manager, vso, monitoring, for example [cert-manager, vso] [List]

existingAddons.description: Releases that already exist with a different chart version or values: skip (report SKIPPED_EXISTS) or upgrade [Enum]
